attempts.name: Vox · Bureau S2
attempts.prompt: Use case: reference-led game environment. Create ONE complete static 2D fighting-game background based on Vox's office seen in Hazbin Hotel season 2. The first attached image is an official episode preview and is the authority for the actual blue/cyan palette, architecture, furniture and room identity. The second attached image is a photograph of a foil trading card showing the same office without characters: use it ONLY to corroborate geometry, furniture and composition; completely disregard the glitter, foil speckles, border, printed text, pink card frame and photographic reflections. This is the office interior, not the exterior of a tower. Preserve the giant thin luminous V centered on the rear blue wall, angular cyan-edged desk, the sharply pointed executive chair behind it, two visitor chairs, dark wall paneling and narrow vertical cyan circuit-light columns, with aquarium glass and very restrained dark coral silhouettes at the far side edges. Produce a clean empty room with NO people, no fish characters, no creatures and no portraits. Adapt the camera to a broad mostly frontal, slightly elevated three-quarter fighting-game composition, with the office desk and chairs in the rear half and a wide continuous unobstructed floor occupying the lower third. Keep the desk recognizable from the reference, and avoid introducing furniture, doors, emblems, technology or architectural details not supported by the references. Deep blue, teal and cyan cel-painted animation background, subtle controlled luminous edges, crisp architectural shapes, coherent perspective, no textures copied from the foil card. Wide 16:9 landscape image, high detail, opaque full-bleed background. No character sprite, no lettering except the architectural V, no logo overlay, no interface, no title, no border, no split panels, no parallax layers, no animation frames. This is a single reference-based adaptation for a fan game; match the observed office rather than a generic futuristic room.
attempts.visualReview: Grand V, bureau angulaire, fauteuil pointu côté caméra, deux sièges visiteurs côté éloigné et encadrements cyan conservés. Disposition corrigée après comparaison. Caméra frontale et piste élargie adaptées au jeu ; panneaux et formes des sièges simplifiés. Pas de fidélité 1:1 certifiée.

Correct it as follows: remove the current three chairs; put the ONE larger sharply pointed executive chair on the CAMERA/near side of the desk, centered slightly left, viewed from BEHIND and facing toward the desk and back wall; put the TWO smaller visitor chairs on the FAR side of the desk, facing toward the camera, their upper backs visible behind the tabletop. Match this side relationship to the official preview. Keep the scene EMPTY, no people. Preserve the same grand cyan V on the back wall, desk shape, architecture, side aquarium frames, coral silhouettes, blue/cyan palette, 16:9 canvas, lighting and clean free floor. Keep all three chairs and the desk within the rear two thirds so the lower third remains a continuous empty playing surface. Do not add text, card borders, glitter, another desk, a fourth chair, props, characters, UI or animation. This is one complete opaque static environment image.
